ABC Cash tracks your cash flow simply: record income and expenses, plan with forecasts, and monitor your treasury balance.
Add money in or out in seconds. Choose a category and date — past or today goes to Transactions, future dates go to Forecasts. Attach a receipt photo for expenses.
The Forecasts tab lists upcoming income and expenses not yet settled. This is your cash outlook for the coming months.
Settled income and paid expenses appear in Transactions — your real cash movements, month by month.
The Treasury screen shows your running balance and rolling forecast so you always know if cash is healthy.
